page.layout: One column of verse, set in italic with indented lines; page number at top right; running head at top centre.

main_text.p:
Idem vrbe capta fronte non trifti ferox,
Non impotens victoria,
Non ira & odio feuus implacabili,
Non efferatus caedibus,
Perambulauit liberas metu vias,
Ceu pace festa exercitus.
Non infolentis militis formidine
Matrona cultus exuit.
Non officina claufa merces abdidit,
Non hostes aurum credidit
Solo refossô.
Non pudori filiæ
Parens, maritus coniugi
Vim expauit vllam.

Subitus oppressæ sonus
Vrbis, tubarum & cornuum
Clangor, virorum clamor, armorum fragor,
Vulgi insidebant auribus.
Cædes ob oculos, & fuga, & ferrum madens
Cruore nondum frigido,
Voluebat animus quid facere vincor, pati
Victus foleret: tot tamen
Inter timores vim timere te duce
Nemo sibi permiserat.

Cùm tu tot animos militum, tot ensium
Sic temperares impetum,
Ceu verfat animus corpus unum, & corpore
Enata ab uno brachia.

Natura genitrix tam nouam discordiam
Rerum videns concordiam,

page.notes: The scan is a little faint, and some words are hard to be certain of. Several lines in the first stanzas are unclear and were filled from my best reading, so they should be checked against the original. A few readings are marked here for review: "Cùm" and "ensium" in the third stanza, and "Voluebat" in the second. The signature "F. iv." is printed at the foot of the page. The line "Subitus oppressæ sonus" looks like a rendering, not a reading I can confirm letter by letter.
